SELECT COMPANY_CODE , CSMHSE_CODE , SUBMIT_NO , STTEMNT_DOC_STLE , DRWBAK_SE_CODE , XPORT_TYPE , ACNUTNO , BANK_CODE , BASS_UNIT , ACCMLT_ORDER_QY , STTEMNT_PC_KRW , REQREQY_CALC_MTH , STD_ITEM_NM , HS_CODE , ECTMRK , BIZRNO , CALC_DRWBAK_AMOUNT AS CUD , IND , "5AA" , ACT , "5AB" , CAP , CALC_DRWBAK_AMOUNT AS "5CZ" , NATION_CODE , MANUFAC_BIZRNO , MANUFAC_ECTMRK FROM( SELECT A.COMPANY_CODE , COMP.CSMHSE_CODE /* 세관코드 */ , A.SUBMIT_NO /* 제출번호 */ , A.STTEMNT_DOC_STLE /* 문서형태구분(GOVCBR5DA) */ , A.DRWBAK_SE_CODE /* 환급구분 코드 개별환급 : 3 */ , A.XPORT_TYPE , A.ACNUTNO , A.BANK_CODE , A.BASS_UNIT , ISSUE.ISSUE_ACCMLT_ORDER_QY AS ACCMLT_ORDER_QY , ISSUE.ISSUE_STTEMNT_PC_KRW AS STTEMNT_PC_KRW , A.REQREQY_CALC_MTH , SUBSTR((SELECT ITM.ITEM_NM FROM DRWBAK_REQSTDOC_TRGET_THNG ITM WHERE ITM.PRESENTN_NO = A.PRESENTN_NO AND ITM.DIVISION_CODE = A.DIVISION_CODE AND ROWNUM = 1),1, 299) AS STD_ITEM_NM ,A.HS_CODE ,COMP.ECTMRK ,COMP.BIZRNO ,A.CSTMS AS CUD -- 관세 ,A.INTTAX AS IND -- 개별소비세액 ,A.TRANTAX AS "5AA" -- 교통에너지환경세액 ,A.LQTX_AMOUNT AS ACT -- 주세액 ,A.ECX_AMOUNT AS "5AB" -- 교육세액 ,A.AGSPT AS CAP -- 농특세액 ,A.DRWBAK_AMOUNT AS "5CZ" -- 세액 합계 ,CASE WHEN A.NATION_CODE IN ('CN', 'EU', 'US') THEN A.NATION_CODE ELSE 'ZZ' END AS NATION_CODE ,CASE WHEN A.MANUFAC_NAME = '미상' THEN '0000000000' WHEN A.MANUFAC_NAME LIKE '%아모레퍼시픽%' THEN (SELECT CC.BIZRNO FROM COMPANY CC WHERE CC.COMPANY_CODE = '1100' AND ROWNUM = 1) WHEN A.MANUFAC_NAME LIKE '%코스비젼%' THEN (SELECT CC.BIZRNO FROM COMPANY CC WHERE CC.COMPANY_CODE = '1500' AND ROWNUM = 1) END AS MANUFAC_BIZRNO ,CASE WHEN A.MANUFAC_NAME = '미상' THEN '제조미상9999000' WHEN A.MANUFAC_NAME LIKE '%아모레퍼시픽%' THEN (SELECT CC.ECTMRK FROM COMPANY CC WHERE CC.COMPANY_CODE = '1100' AND ROWNUM = 1) WHEN A.MANUFAC_NAME LIKE '%코스비젼%' THEN (SELECT CC.ECTMRK FROM COMPANY CC WHERE CC.COMPANY_CODE = '1500' AND ROWNUM = 1) END AS MANUFAC_ECTMRK /* 환급 총액 별도 계산 */ ,TRUNC((SELECT TRUNC(SUM(TAX_SUM), -1) FROM (SELECT (CASE WHEN B.IMP_BASS_UNIT = A.BASS_UNIT THEN A.USGQTY ELSE (CASE WHEN B.IMP_BASS_UNIT = 'KG' THEN A.USGQTY / 1000 WHEN B.IMP_BASS_UNIT = 'LB' THEN A.USGQTY / 0.453592 / 1000 WHEN B.IMP_BASS_UNIT = 'DR' THEN A.USGQTY / 1000 / 30 WHEN B.IMP_BASS_UNIT = 'GR' THEN A.USGQTY / 0.064799 WHEN B.IMP_BASS_UNIT = 'MT' THEN A.USGQTY / 1000 / 1000 ELSE B.QY END) END) AS USGQTY, TRUNC(A.CSTMS) + TRUNC(A.INTTAX) + TRUNC(A.ECX_AMOUNT) + TRUNC(A.AGSPT) + TRUNC(A.TRANTAX) + TRUNC(A.LQTX_AMOUNT) AS TAX_SUM FROM DRWBAK_REQSTDOC_INCME_RAWMTRL A INNER JOIN INCME_LOCAL_BNT_SM B ON A.COMPANY_CODE = B.COMPANY_CODE AND A.RAWMTRL_CODE = B.ITEM_CODE AND A.LNE_NO = B.LNE_NO AND A.POUCH_NO = B.POUCH_NO AND A.IMPDEC_NO = B.IMPDEC_NO
WHERE TRUNC(A.CSTMS, 4) > 0 AND A.COMPANY_CODE = #{COMPANY_CODE} AND A.PRESENTN_NO = #{PRESENTN_NO}) WHERE TRUNC(USGQTY, 3) > 0.000999999999999), -1) AS CALC_DRWBAK_AMOUNT FROM DRWBAK_REQSTDOC_CMMN A INNER JOIN COMPANY COMP ON A.COMPANY_CODE = COMP.COMPANY_CODE /* 발급대상만 수량 및 판매금액 계산 */ INNER JOIN (SELECT COMPANY_CODE, DIVISION_CODE, PRESENTN_NO, SUM(ACCMLT_ORDER_QY) AS ISSUE_ACCMLT_ORDER_QY, SUM(STTEMNT_PC_KRW) AS ISSUE_STTEMNT_PC_KRW FROM (SELECT DISTINCT COMPANY_CODE, DIVISION_CODE, PRESENTN_NO, XPORT_STTEMNT_NO, LNE_NO, POUCH_NO, ACCMLT_ORDER_QY, BASS_UNIT, STTEMNT_PC_KRW, THNG_SEQ FROM (SELECT T.COMPANY_CODE, T.DIVISION_CODE, T.PRESENTN_NO, T.XPORT_STTEMNT_NO, T.LNE_NO, T.POUCH_NO, T.ACCMLT_ORDER_QY, T.BASS_UNIT, TRUNC(T.STTEMNT_PC_KRW) AS STTEMNT_PC_KRW, T.THNG_SEQ, CASE WHEN B.IMP_BASS_UNIT = A.BASS_UNIT THEN A.USGQTY ELSE (CASE WHEN B.IMP_BASS_UNIT = 'KG' THEN A.USGQTY / 1000 WHEN B.IMP_BASS_UNIT = 'LB' THEN A.USGQTY / 0.453592 / 1000 WHEN B.IMP_BASS_UNIT = 'DR' THEN A.USGQTY / 1000 / 30 WHEN B.IMP_BASS_UNIT = 'GR' THEN A.USGQTY / 0.064799 WHEN B.IMP_BASS_UNIT = 'MT' THEN A.USGQTY / 1000 / 1000 ELSE B.QY END) END AS USGQTY FROM DRWBAK_REQSTDOC_TRGET_THNG T INNER JOIN DRWBAK_REQSTDOC_INCME_RAWMTRL A ON T.COMPANY_CODE = A.COMPANY_CODE AND T.PRESENTN_NO = A.PRESENTN_NO AND T.THNG_SEQ = A.THNG_SEQ INNER JOIN INCME_LOCAL_BNT_SM B ON A.COMPANY_CODE = B.COMPANY_CODE AND A.RAWMTRL_CODE = B.ITEM_CODE AND A.LNE_NO = B.LNE_NO AND A.POUCH_NO = B.POUCH_NO AND A.IMPDEC_NO = B.IMPDEC_NO
WHERE TRUNC(A.CSTMS, 4) > 0 AND T.COMPANY_CODE = #{COMPANY_CODE} AND T.PRESENTN_NO = #{PRESENTN_NO}) X WHERE TRUNC(USGQTY, 3) > 0.000999999999999) GROUP BY COMPANY_CODE, DIVISION_CODE, PRESENTN_NO) ISSUE ON A.COMPANY_CODE = ISSUE.COMPANY_CODE AND A.DIVISION_CODE = ISSUE.DIVISION_CODE AND A.PRESENTN_NO = ISSUE.PRESENTN_NO WHERE A.PRESENTN_NO = #{PRESENTN_NO} AND A.COMPANY_CODE = #{COMPANY_CODE} AND A.DIVISION_CODE = #{DIVISION_CODE} )

SELECT LPAD(ROWNUM, 4, '0') AS LINE_NUMBER, ITEM_CODE, XPORT_DIV_CODE, XPORT_STTEMNT_NO, LPAD(LNE_NO, 3, '0') AS LNE_NO, LPAD(POUCH_NO, 2, '0') AS POUCH_NO, DSPTH_DATE, ACCMLT_ORDER_QY, BASS_UNIT, STTEMNT_PC_KRW FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT ITEM_CODE, XPORT_DIV_CODE, XPORT_STTEMNT_NO, LNE_NO, POUCH_NO, DSPTH_DATE, ACCMLT_ORDER_QY, BASS_UNIT, STTEMNT_PC_KRW, THNG_SEQ FROM (SELECT T.ITEM_CODE, '01' AS XPORT_DIV_CODE, T.XPORT_STTEMNT_NO, T.LNE_NO, T.POUCH_NO, T.DSPTH_DATE, T.ACCMLT_ORDER_QY, T.BASS_UNIT, TRUNC(T.STTEMNT_PC_KRW) AS STTEMNT_PC_KRW, T.THNG_SEQ, CASE WHEN B.IMP_BASS_UNIT = A.BASS_UNIT THEN A.USGQTY ELSE (CASE WHEN B.IMP_BASS_UNIT = 'KG' THEN A.USGQTY / 1000 WHEN B.IMP_BASS_UNIT = 'LB' THEN A.USGQTY / 0.453592 / 1000 WHEN B.IMP_BASS_UNIT = 'DR' THEN A.USGQTY / 1000 / 30 WHEN B.IMP_BASS_UNIT = 'GR' THEN A.USGQTY / 0.064799 WHEN B.IMP_BASS_UNIT = 'MT' THEN A.USGQTY / 1000 / 1000 ELSE B.QY END) END AS USGQTY FROM DRWBAK_REQSTDOC_TRGET_THNG T INNER JOIN DRWBAK_REQSTDOC_INCME_RAWMTRL A ON T.COMPANY_CODE = A.COMPANY_CODE AND T.PRESENTN_NO = A.PRESENTN_NO AND T.THNG_SEQ = A.THNG_SEQ INNER JOIN INCME_LOCAL_BNT_SM B ON A.COMPANY_CODE = B.COMPANY_CODE AND A.RAWMTRL_CODE = B.ITEM_CODE AND A.LNE_NO = B.LNE_NO AND A.POUCH_NO = B.POUCH_NO AND A.IMPDEC_NO = B.IMPDEC_NO
WHERE TRUNC(A.CSTMS, 4) > 0 AND T.COMPANY_CODE = #{COMPANY_CODE} AND T.PRESENTN_NO = #{PRESENTN_NO} AND T.DIVISION_CODE = #{DIVISION_CODE} ORDER BY XPORT_STTEMNT_NO, LNE_NO, POUCH_NO) X WHERE TRUNC(USGQTY, 3) > 0.000999999999999 ORDER BY X.XPORT_STTEMNT_NO, X.LNE_NO, X.POUCH_NO )

SELECT LPAD(ROWNUM, 5, '0') AS LINE_NUMBER, LPAD(POUCH_NO, 2, '0') AS POUCH_NO, LPAD(LNE_NO, 3, '0') AS LNE_NO, RAWMTRL_SE, RAWMTRL_CODE, ITEM_CODE, BASS_UNIT, USGQTY, IMPDEC_NO, ACPT_DATE, HS_CODE, --UNIT_PRICE, CUD, IND, "5AA", ACT, "5AB", CAP, "5CZ" FROM (SELECT A.POUCH_NO, A.LNE_NO, A.RAWMTRL_SE, A.RAWMTRL_CODE, A.ITEM_CODE, B.IMP_BASS_UNIT AS BASS_UNIT, TRUNC(CASE WHEN B.IMP_BASS_UNIT = A.BASS_UNIT THEN A.USGQTY ELSE (CASE WHEN B.IMP_BASS_UNIT = 'KG' THEN A.USGQTY / 1000 WHEN B.IMP_BASS_UNIT = 'LB' THEN A.USGQTY / 0.453592 / 1000 WHEN B.IMP_BASS_UNIT = 'DR' THEN A.USGQTY / 1000 / 30 WHEN B.IMP_BASS_UNIT = 'GR' THEN A.USGQTY / 0.064799 WHEN B.IMP_BASS_UNIT = 'MT' THEN A.USGQTY / 1000 / 1000 ELSE B.QY END) END, 3) AS USGQTY, A.IMPDEC_NO, A.ACPT_DATE, B.HS_CODE, --C.UNIT_PRICE, TRUNC(A.CSTMS) AS CUD, -- 관세 TRUNC(A.INTTAX) AS IND, -- 개별소비세액 TRUNC(A.TRANTAX) AS "5AA", -- 교통에너지환경세액 TRUNC(A.LQTX_AMOUNT) AS ACT, -- 주세액 TRUNC(A.ECX_AMOUNT) AS "5AB", -- 교육세액 TRUNC(A.AGSPT) AS CAP, -- 농특세액 TRUNC(A.DRWBAK_AMOUNT) AS "5CZ" -- 세액 합계
FROM DRWBAK_REQSTDOC_INCME_RAWMTRL A INNER JOIN INCME_LOCAL_BNT_SM B ON A.COMPANY_CODE = B.COMPANY_CODE AND A.RAWMTRL_CODE = B.ITEM_CODE AND A.LNE_NO = B.LNE_NO AND A.POUCH_NO = B.POUCH_NO AND A.IMPDEC_NO = B.IMPDEC_NO
WHERE TRUNC(A.CSTMS, 4) > 0 AND A.PRESENTN_NO = #{PRESENTN_NO} AND A.COMPANY_CODE = #{COMPANY_CODE} ORDER BY THNG_SEQ, RAWMTRL_SEQ) WHERE TRUNC(USGQTY, 3) > 0.000999999999999

mapper.select: SELECT A.PRESENTN_NO , A.STTEMNT_DOC_STLE , A.CSMHSE_CODE , A.ECTMRK , A.BIZRNO , A.CSTMR_ECTMRK , A.CSTMR_BIZRNO , A.HS_CODE , A.CHIT_FRMTRM_DATE , A.ACPLC_CRNCY , A.CSTMS AS CUD -- 관세 , A.INTTAX AS IND -- 개별소비세액 , A.TRANTAX AS "5AA" -- 교통에너지환경세액 , A.LQTX_AMOUNT AS ACT -- 주세액 , A.ECX_AMOUNT AS "5AB" -- 교육세액 , A.AGSPT AS CAP -- 농특세액 , A.DRWBAK_AMOUNT AS "5CZ" -- 세액 합계 , B.TELNO_1 , NULL AS AGENT_ID , A.STTEMNT_PC_KRW , A.ACCMLT_ORDER_QY , A.BASS_UNIT , A.SUBMIT_NO , B.UNIPASS_ID -- 유니패스ID , B.UNIPASS_DOC_BOX_CODE -- 문서함코드 , '' AS UNIPASS_STATUS -- 유니패스 상태값 , 'GOVCBR5DE' AS STTEMNT_DOC_STLE -- 문서형태코드 , A.EXECUT_AT , A.EXECUT_STATUS FROM CTRM_CMMN A INNER JOIN COMPANY B ON A.COMPANY_CODE = B.COMPANY_CODE WHERE A.ISSUE_TYPE = '04' AND A.COMPANY_CODE = #{COMPANY_CODE} AND A.PRESENTN_NO = #{PRESENTN_NO} AND A.STTEMNT_PC_KRW > 0

SELECT LPAD(ROWNUM, 3, '0') AS LINE_NUMBER , RAWMTRL_SE, IMPDEC_NO, LNE_NO, GOODS_BRAND, ORGIN_NATION_CODE, USGQTY , BASS_UNIT, ACPT_DATE, DATE_EX, BASIS_DOC_NO , CUD, IND, "5AA", ACT, "5AB", CAP, "5CZ", POUCH_NO, RAWMTRL_CODE, ITEM_NM, STTEMNT_PC_KRW, ACPLC_CRNCY FROM (SELECT RAWMTRL_SE , IMPDEC_NO , LNE_NO , GOODS_BRAND , ORGIN_NATION_CODE , SUM(USGQTY) AS USGQTY , BASS_UNIT , ACPT_DATE , DATE_EX , BASIS_DOC_NO , SUM(CUD) AS CUD , SUM(IND) AS IND , SUM("5AA") AS "5AA" , SUM(ACT) AS ACT , SUM("5AB") AS "5AB" , SUM(CAP) AS CAP , SUM("5CZ") AS "5CZ" , POUCH_NO , RAWMTRL_CODE , ITEM_NM , SUM(STTEMNT_PC_KRW) AS STTEMNT_PC_KRW , ACPLC_CRNCY FROM ( SELECT A.RAWMTRL_SE , A.IMPDEC_NO , LPAD(A.LNE_NO, 3, '0') AS LNE_NO , A.GOODS_BRAND , A.ORGIN_NATION_CODE , TRUNC(CASE WHEN B.IMP_BASS_UNIT = A.BASS_UNIT THEN A.USGQTY ELSE (CASE WHEN B.IMP_BASS_UNIT = 'KG' THEN A.USGQTY / 1000 WHEN B.IMP_BASS_UNIT = 'LB' THEN A.USGQTY / 0.453592 / 1000 WHEN B.IMP_BASS_UNIT = 'DR' THEN A.USGQTY / 1000 / 30 WHEN B.IMP_BASS_UNIT = 'GR' THEN A.USGQTY / 0.064799 WHEN B.IMP_BASS_UNIT = 'MT' THEN A.USGQTY / 1000 / 1000 ELSE B.QY END) END, 3) AS USGQTY , B.IMP_BASS_UNIT AS BASS_UNIT , A.ACPT_DATE , A.DATE_EX , '['||LPAD(A.SUPT_DOC_SE, 2,'0')||']매매계약서 등' AS BASIS_DOC_NO , A.CSTMS AS CUD -- 관세 , A.INTTAX AS IND -- 개별소비세액 , A.TRANTAX AS "5AA" -- 교통에너지환경세액 , A.LQTX_AMOUNT AS ACT -- 주세액 , A.ECX_AMOUNT AS "5AB" -- 교육세액 , A.AGSPT AS CAP -- 농특세액 , A.DRWBAK_AMOUNT AS "5CZ" -- 세액 합계 , LPAD(A.POUCH_NO, 2, '0') AS POUCH_NO , A.RAWMTRL_CODE , A.ITEM_NM , A.STTEMNT_PC_KRW , A.ACPLC_CRNCY FROM CTRM_THING_RAWMTRL A INNER JOIN INCME_LOCAL_BNT_SM B ON A.COMPANY_CODE = B.COMPANY_CODE AND A.IMPDEC_NO = B.IMPDEC_NO AND A.LNE_NO = B.LNE_NO AND A.POUCH_NO = B.POUCH_NO AND A.RAWMTRL_CODE = B.ITEM_CODE WHERE A.COMPANY_CODE = #{COMPANY_CODE} AND A.PRESENTN_NO = #{PRESENTN_NO} AND A.STTEMNT_PC_KRW > 0 AND A.CSTMS > 0 ) A GROUP BY RAWMTRL_SE , IMPDEC_NO , LNE_NO , GOODS_BRAND , ORGIN_NATION_CODE , BASS_UNIT , ACPT_DATE , DATE_EX , BASIS_DOC_NO , POUCH_NO , RAWMTRL_CODE , ITEM_NM , ACPLC_CRNCY ) LST

SELECT A.PRESENTN_NO , A.STTEMNT_DOC_STLE , A.CHIT_FRMTRM_DATE , A.DATE_EX , A.DRWBAK_SE_CODE , A.CSMHSE_CODE , A.ECTMRK , A.BIZRNO , A.CSTMR_TELNO , A.CSTMR_ECTMRK , A.CSTMR_BIZRNO , A.HS_CODE , A.REQREQY_CALC_MTH , NVL(ISSUE.STTEMNT_PC_KRW, 0) AS STTEMNT_PC_KRW , ISSUE.ACCMLT_ORDER_QY , A.BASS_UNIT , TAX.TAX_SUM AS CUD -- 관세 , A.INTTAX AS IND -- 개별소비세액 , A.TRANTAX AS "5AA" -- 교통에너지환경세액 , A.LQTX_AMOUNT AS ACT -- 주세액 , A.ECX_AMOUNT AS "5AB" -- 교육세액 , A.AGSPT AS CAP -- 농특세액 , TAX.TAX_SUM AS "5CZ" -- 총세액 , A.SUBMIT_NO , B.UNIPASS_ID -- 유니패스ID , B.UNIPASS_DOC_BOX_CODE -- 문서함코드 , '' AS UNIPASS_STATUS -- 유니패스 상태값 , 'GOVCBR5DB' AS STTEMNT_DOC_STLE -- 문서형태코드 , A.EXECUT_AT , A.EXECUT_STATUS , TAX.TAX_SUM AS DRWBAK_AMOUNT FROM CTRM_CMMN A INNER JOIN ( SELECT PRESENTN_NO ,COMPANY_CODE ,DIVISION_CODE ,SUM(ACCMLT_ORDER_QY) AS ACCMLT_ORDER_QY ,SUM(STTEMNT_PC_KRW) AS STTEMNT_PC_KRW FROM (SELECT DISTINCT PRESENTN_NO , COMPANY_CODE , DIVISION_CODE , ACCMLT_ORDER_QY , STTEMNT_PC_KRW
FROM (SELECT A.PRESENTN_NO , A.COMPANY_CODE , A.DIVISION_CODE , A.ACCMLT_ORDER_QY , A.STTEMNT_PC_KRW , CASE WHEN B.IMP_BASS_UNIT = AA.BASS_UNIT THEN AA.USGQTY ELSE (CASE WHEN B.IMP_BASS_UNIT = 'KG' THEN AA.USGQTY / 1000 WHEN B.IMP_BASS_UNIT = 'LB' THEN AA.USGQTY / 0.453592 / 1000 WHEN B.IMP_BASS_UNIT = 'DR' THEN AA.USGQTY / 1000 / 30 WHEN B.IMP_BASS_UNIT = 'GR' THEN AA.USGQTY / 0.064799 WHEN B.IMP_BASS_UNIT = 'MT' THEN AA.USGQTY / 1000 / 1000 ELSE B.QY END) END AS USGQTY FROM CTRM_TRGET_THNG A INNER JOIN CTRM_INCME_RAWMTRL AA ON A.COMPANY_CODE = AA.COMPANY_CODE AND A.DIVISION_CODE = AA.DIVISION_CODE AND A.PRESENTN_NO = AA.PRESENTN_NO AND A.SEQ = AA.SEQ INNER JOIN INCME_LOCAL_BNT_SM B ON AA.COMPANY_CODE = B.COMPANY_CODE AND AA.IMPDEC_NO = B.IMPDEC_NO AND AA.LNE_NO = B.LNE_NO AND AA.POUCH_NO = B.POUCH_NO AND AA.RAWMTRL_CODE = B.ITEM_CODE WHERE A.COMPANY_CODE = #{COMPANY_CODE} AND A.DIVISION_CODE = #{DIVISION_CODE} AND A.PRESENTN_NO = #{PRESENTN_NO} AND AA.CSTMS > 9.9999999999999 ) WHERE TRUNC(USGQTY, 3) > 0.000999999999999 ) GROUP BY PRESENTN_NO, COMPANY_CODE, DIVISION_CODE) ISSUE ON A.COMPANY_CODE = ISSUE.COMPANY_CODE AND A.DIVISION_CODE = ISSUE.DIVISION_CODE AND A.PRESENTN_NO = ISSUE.PRESENTN_NO INNER JOIN (SELECT A.PRESENTN_NO , A.COMPANY_CODE , A.DIVISION_CODE ,TRUNC(SUM(TAX_SUM), -1) AS TAX_SUM FROM ( SELECT A.PRESENTN_NO , A.COMPANY_CODE , A.DIVISION_CODE , TRUNC(CASE WHEN B.IMP_BASS_UNIT = A.BASS_UNIT THEN A.USGQTY ELSE (CASE WHEN B.IMP_BASS_UNIT = 'KG' THEN A.USGQTY / 1000 WHEN B.IMP_BASS_UNIT = 'LB' THEN A.USGQTY / 0.453592 / 1000 WHEN B.IMP_BASS_UNIT = 'DR' THEN A.USGQTY / 1000 / 30 WHEN B.IMP_BASS_UNIT = 'GR' THEN A.USGQTY / 0.064799 WHEN B.IMP_BASS_UNIT = 'MT' THEN A.USGQTY / 1000 / 1000 ELSE B.QY END) END, 3) AS USGQTY , (TRUNC(A.CSTMS, -1) + TRUNC(A.INTTAX, -1) + TRUNC(A.TRANTAX, -1) + TRUNC(A.LQTX_AMOUNT, -1) + TRUNC(A.ECX_AMOUNT, -1) + TRUNC(A.AGSPT, -1)) AS TAX_SUM FROM CTRM_INCME_RAWMTRL A INNER JOIN INCME_LOCAL_BNT_SM B ON A.COMPANY_CODE = B.COMPANY_CODE AND A.IMPDEC_NO = B.IMPDEC_NO AND A.LNE_NO = B.LNE_NO AND A.POUCH_NO = B.POUCH_NO AND A.RAWMTRL_CODE = B.ITEM_CODE WHERE A.COMPANY_CODE = #{COMPANY_CODE} AND A.DIVISION_CODE = #{DIVISION_CODE} AND A.PRESENTN_NO = #{PRESENTN_NO} ) A WHERE TRUNC(USGQTY, 3) > 0.000999999999999 GROUP BY A.PRESENTN_NO, A.COMPANY_CODE, A.DIVISION_CODE) TAX ON A.COMPANY_CODE = TAX.COMPANY_CODE AND A.DIVISION_CODE = TAX.DIVISION_CODE AND A.PRESENTN_NO = TAX.PRESENTN_NO INNER JOIN COMPANY B ON A.COMPANY_CODE = B.COMPANY_CODE WHERE A.ISSUE_TYPE = '02' AND SELECT LPAD(ROWNUM, 3, '0') AS LINE_NUMBER , ITEM_CODE , ITEM_NM , ACCMLT_ORDER_QY , BASS_UNIT , STTEMNT_PC_KRW , KRW_CRNCY , BASIS_DOC_NO , CUD , IND , "5AA" , ACT , "5AB" , CAP , "5CZ" , SUM(CUD) OVER() FROM (SELECT SEQ ,ITEM_CODE , ITEM_NM , ACCMLT_ORDER_QY , BASS_UNIT , STTEMNT_PC_KRW , KRW_CRNCY , BASIS_DOC_NO , SUM(CSTMS) AS CUD , SUM(INTTAX) AS IND , SUM(TRANTAX) AS "5AA" , SUM(LQTX_AMOUNT) AS ACT , SUM(ECX_AMOUNT) AS "5AB" , SUM(AGSPT) AS CAP , SUM(DRWBAK_AMOUNT) AS "5CZ" FROM (SELECT A.SEQ , A.ITEM_CODE , A.ITEM_NM , A.ACCMLT_ORDER_QY , A.BASS_UNIT , A.STTEMNT_PC_KRW , A.KRW_CRNCY , '['||LPAD(A.SUPT_DOC_SE, 2,'0')||']매매계약서 등' AS BASIS_DOC_NO , TRUNC(AA.CSTMS, -1) AS CSTMS -- 관세 , TRUNC(AA.INTTAX, -1) AS INTTAX -- 개별소비세액 , TRUNC(AA.TRANTAX, -1) AS TRANTAX -- 교통에너지환경세액 , TRUNC(AA.LQTX_AMOUNT, -1) AS LQTX_AMOUNT -- 주세액 , TRUNC(AA.ECX_AMOUNT, -1) AS ECX_AMOUNT -- 교육세액 , TRUNC(AA.AGSPT, -1) AS AGSPT -- 농특세액 , TRUNC(AA.DRWBAK_AMOUNT,-1) AS DRWBAK_AMOUNT -- 세액 합계 , TRUNC(CASE WHEN B.IMP_BASS_UNIT = AA.BASS_UNIT THEN AA.USGQTY ELSE (CASE WHEN B.IMP_BASS_UNIT = 'KG' THEN AA.USGQTY / 1000 WHEN B.IMP_BASS_UNIT = 'LB' THEN AA.USGQTY / 0.453592 / 1000 WHEN B.IMP_BASS_UNIT = 'DR' THEN AA.USGQTY / 1000 / 30 WHEN B.IMP_BASS_UNIT = 'GR' THEN AA.USGQTY / 0.064799 WHEN B.IMP_BASS_UNIT = 'MT' THEN AA.USGQTY / 1000 / 1000 ELSE B.QY END) END, 3) AS USGQTY FROM CTRM_TRGET_THNG A INNER JOIN CTRM_INCME_RAWMTRL AA ON A.COMPANY_CODE = AA.COMPANY_CODE AND A.DIVISION_CODE = AA.DIVISION_CODE AND A.PRESENTN_NO = AA.PRESENTN_NO AND A.SEQ = AA.SEQ INNER JOIN INCME_LOCAL_BNT_SM B ON AA.COMPANY_CODE = B.COMPANY_CODE AND AA.IMPDEC_NO = B.IMPDEC_NO AND AA.LNE_NO = B.LNE_NO AND AA.POUCH_NO = B.POUCH_NO AND AA.RAWMTRL_CODE = B.ITEM_CODE WHERE A.COMPANY_CODE = #{COMPANY_CODE} AND A.PRESENTN_NO = #{PRESENTN_NO} ) WHERE USGQTY > 0.000999999999999 GROUP BY ITEM_CODE, ITEM_NM, ACCMLT_ORDER_QY, BASS_UNIT, STTEMNT_PC_KRW, KRW_CRNCY, BASIS_DOC_NO,SEQ ORDER BY SEQ ASC ) WHERE "5CZ" > 0
